original_target.title: Exclusion of coexistence for unequal Richardson growth rates

scope_comparison: Theorem 1 of 1808.10796 proves exclusion on a half-plane with boundary seeds. It does not cover every unequal rate on the full lattice. Equal-rate coexistence applications and a countable exceptional-rate exclusion leave the target quantifier unresolved.
queries: "Richardson model" "coexistence" (site:arxiv.org OR site:zenodo.org OR site:hal.science OR site:github.com) "rates"
